request: Redesign experiments from data onward, adapting only necessary ideas from the reviewed papers.
scope: Real streaming-video feasibility plus unchanged original paired-physics acceptance; no learned deletion policy in Phase 1.

primary_data.split_origin: SPACE participant-disjoint custom protocol, not official Assembly101 task split
primary_data.data_access: User acceptance of official HF dataset contact-sharing conditions required before download; do not bypass.
primary_data.timestamp_source: Actual video PTS; official annotations use 30fps-extracted frame IDs, raw video nominal60fps.
primary_data.episode_reset: All methods clear memory at the same episode start, not at action boundaries.
primary_data.short_video_policy: No padding or concatenation; report insufficient-duration exclusions. No outcome-based replacement. Stop if a planned participant lacks eligible data.
primary_data.query_condition: All four target frames inside the episode; same grid across methods and capacities.

encoder.causality: Exactly one observed RGB frame per feature; no centered multi-frame window.

reader.basis_and_normalization: Train-only once; original synthetic fits reused for development bridge.
reader.output: current + train target mean + predicted coefficients times train-only residual basis; score full normalized target features.
reader.position: Actual age/time metadata remains identical under deletion; no reindex-based ordinal position.
reader.synthetic_additional_inputs: Original legal past controls and horizon-specific planned-control prefix, never h6 controls in h3.

real_training.loss: Equal-weight normalized full-feature MSE across all four horizons
real_training.selection: Earliest minimum equal-weight four-condition by four-horizon validation MSE

synthetic_training.selection: Original earliest equal four-condition by two-horizon validation MSE

reader.architecture_compute_comparison: Report actual parameters/MACs/time; matched data/steps does not imply identical architecture compute.

real_readout.fit_target: Observed true encoded-frame active-verb union; no policy or predictor loss gradient.
real_readout.task_nll: Mean 24 Bernoulli negative log likelihoods; all valid queries primary, foreground/background/boundary strata additional.

memory.admission: The item exiting recent becomes incoming history; fill free slots, otherwise permanently delete one of K+1 including possible rejection of incoming.

stage_A.question: Can encoded historical evidence be used by the common future predictor?
real_required_checks: True-future readout beats train-frequency prior with participant-paired interval
Full episode history beats recent-only full-feature MSE at h16 and h64, each seed and participant-pooled interval
The same contrast improves future-action NLL at h16/h64, each seed and pooled
stage_A.additional: Report every horizon and stratum, original basis oracle feasibility and all four memory conditions; no hidden-coordinate-only score.
stage_A.synthetic_required_checks: All original task rules plus fixed v3-reference recent and critical absolute privileged-MSE checks; no changed thresholds.
stage_A.stop: If real features/readout or actual reader/history checks fail, report the unresolved bottleneck; no automatic encoder change, rank expansion or selector training.

stage_B.question: Do different deletions have measurable consequences under one frozen predictor?
stage_B.state_sampling: Uniform deterministic valid full-memory states across eligible episodes, no loss/label-driven selection.
stage_B.continuation_policy: Reservoir with common observed future and coupled per-update random draws across forks.
stage_B.cost: 0.5 times immediate four-horizon MSE mean plus 0.5 times 32-step mean of four-horizon MSE
stage_B.oracle_choice: One joint-cost minimizer per state; exact ties delete earliest real timestamp. Do not separately pick the h16/h64 winners.
stage_B.real_required_checks: Joint-cost oracle gain and gains at h16 and h64 versus both FIFO and Reservoir, positive intervals for every seed and participant-pooled estimate.
stage_B.meaning: Auxiliary oracle headroom, not a deployable result or evidence a lightweight policy can learn it.
stage_B.synthetic_control: Original evidence timestamps plus filler form three entries; all deletion alternatives retain exactly two; report gate cue and motion start/end contrasts separately.

stage_C.question: What happens after repeated irreversible eviction?
stage_C.trajectories: Chronological per-episode replay; same stream/queries/encoder/reader/decoder/capacity across each matched comparison.
metrics: Every-horizon feature MSE and verb NLL

corruption.donor: Same episode, older different annotated activity; evaluator injection only, never archive access for policy

statistics.real_unit: Participant, after within-episode then recording and participant aggregation; equal participant weights.

decision_rules.independent_confirmation_requires: Both original-task actual development adoption comparisons supported, real signal supported, all actual current checkpoint proofs complete and valid.
decision_rules.confirmation_real: 18 sealed recordings from9 held-out participants; all3 real predictors and decoder fixed before feature/label evaluation; no test adaptation.
decision_rules.phase2_policy_training: Separate future protocol after Phase1, not included in present design.

proposed_compute_limits.confirmation: Separate locked resource plan only after actual gates. No present allocation.
proposed_compute_limits.over_budget: Stop and report; do not silently reduce tasks, resolution, epochs, seeds or increase walltime.

necessary_changes: Real procedural-video data and subject splits
One generic temporal reader, shared across memory policies
Direct B+1-to-B and continuous eviction evaluation
not_adopted: Slow predictive basin and utility retrieval bank
before_execution: Complete code and meaningful information-boundary smoke/preflight; software success is not science
Resolve earlier unspecified model switch without repeating its pending question
User completes official Assembly101 access conditions before any gated-data download
Hash-lock actual manifest/code/config; source and old outputs isolated
Verify current scheduler/course allocation identity; no dead-IP retries
legacy_v4_gate: Prepared but unsubmitted; not automatically combined with v5 reader candidate.
